description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Redshift::UsageLimit. Creates a usage limit for a specified Amazon Redshift feature on a cluster. The usage limit is identified by the returned usage limit identifier.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the usage limit.
Arn.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the usage limit.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Pattern: ^arn:aws[a-z0-9-]*:redshift:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:usagelimit:.+$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

UsageLimitId.description: The identifier of the usage limit.
UsageLimitId.markdownDescription:
The identifier of the usage limit.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

ClusterIdentifier.description: The identifier of the cluster that you want to limit usage.
ClusterIdentifier.markdownDescription:
The identifier of the cluster that you want to limit usage.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Update requires: Replacement

FeatureType.description: The Amazon Redshift feature that you want to limit.
FeatureType.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Redshift feature that you want to limit.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: spectrum | concurrency-scaling | cross-region-datasharing | extra-compute-for-automatic-optimization  
Update requires: Replacement

LimitType.description: The type of limit. Depending on the feature type, this can be based on a time duration or data size. If FeatureType is spectrum, then LimitType must be data-scanned. If FeatureType is concurrency-scaling, then LimitType must be time. If FeatureType is cross-region-datasharing, then LimitType must be data-scanned.
LimitType.markdownDescription:
The type of limit. Depending on the feature type, this can be based on a time duration or data size. If FeatureType is spectrum, then LimitType must be data-scanned. If FeatureType is concurrency-scaling, then LimitType must be time. If FeatureType is cross-region-datasharing, then LimitType must be data-scanned.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: time | data-scanned  
Update requires: Replacement

Amount.description: The limit amount. If time-based, this amount is in minutes. If data-based, this amount is in terabytes (TB). The value must be a positive number.
Amount.markdownDescription:
The limit amount. If time-based, this amount is in minutes. If data-based, this amount is in terabytes (TB). The value must be a positive number.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: Number  
Update requires: No interruption

Period.description: The time period that the amount applies to. A weekly period begins on Sunday. The default is monthly.
Period.markdownDescription:
The time period that the amount applies to. A weekly period begins on Sunday. The default is monthly.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: daily | weekly | monthly  
Update requires: Replacement

BreachAction.description: The action that Amazon Redshift takes when the limit is reached. The default is log.
BreachAction.markdownDescription:
The action that Amazon Redshift takes when the limit is reached. The default is log.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: log | emit-metric | disable
